title: Foundation Models for visual generation (Generative AI)
reading: The slide surveys foundation models for visual (video) generation, laying out a short timeline of milestone systems: Emu Video (2023), Sora (2024), and Veo 2 (2025). It highlights OpenAI's claim that scaling video generation models is a promising route toward general-purpose simulators of the physical world, citing the OpenAI 'video generation models as world simulators' page as the source.

visuals.assertion: Video generation foundation models have advanced rapidly year over year from 2023 to 2025.
